TRADEMARK LICENSE AGREEMENT

This Trademark License Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of March 15, 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between:

LICENSOR: Meridian Craft Brands, Inc., a Delaware corporation with offices at 88 Distillery Row, Louisville, KY 40202
LICENSEE: Cascadia Provisions Co., a Washington corporation with offices at 1210 Harbor Steps, Seattle, WA 98101

RECITALS
A. Licensor is the owner of United States Trademark Registration No. 5,882,417 for "MERIDIAN NORTH" in International Class 33 (distilled spirits), and Registration No. 6,104,993 for the associated compass-rose device mark (collectively, the "Licensed Marks").
B. Licensee desires to manufacture, distribute, and sell canned cocktail products bearing the Licensed Marks in the Territory defined below.

1. GRANT OF LICENSE
1.1 Subject to the terms of this Agreement, Licensor grants Licensee a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the Licensed Marks solely in connection with the ready-to-drink canned cocktail products described on Exhibit A (the "Licensed Products") in the Territory during the Term.
1.2 "Territory" means the fifty United States, the District of Columbia, and Puerto Rico.
1.3 Licensee shall not sublicense the Licensed Marks without Licensor's prior written consent.

2. QUALITY CONTROL
2.1 Licensee shall manufacture the Licensed Products in strict accordance with the specifications set forth on Exhibit B, including the alcohol-by-volume tolerances (±0.3% ABV) and the flavor profile panels approved by Licensor's Master Blender, Dr. Alaina Whitcombe, on February 3, 2026.
2.2 Licensee shall submit representative production samples to Licensor at least thirty (30) days prior to first commercial shipment of each SKU, and thereafter on a quarterly basis. Licensor shall have fifteen (15) business days to approve or reject each sample.
2.3 Failure to maintain quality standards is a material breach curable within thirty (30) days of written notice.

3. ROYALTIES
3.1 Licensee shall pay Licensor a royalty of six percent (6%) of Net Sales of Licensed Products, with a minimum guaranteed royalty of $250,000 per calendar quarter beginning Q3 2026.
3.2 "Net Sales" means gross invoiced amounts less returns, chargebacks, and federal excise tax actually paid.
3.3 Royalty reports and payments are due within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar quarter, accompanied by a written report certified by Licensee's Chief Financial Officer, Renata Ossorio.

4. AUDIT RIGHTS
4.1 Licensor may, on thirty (30) days' notice and no more than once per calendar year, audit Licensee's books and records relating to the Licensed Products.
4.2 If an audit reveals an underpayment exceeding five percent (5%) for the audited period, Licensee shall reimburse Licensor's reasonable audit costs in addition to the underpaid royalties plus interest at 1.5% per month.

5. TERM AND TERMINATION
5.1 The initial term is five (5) years, with automatic renewal for successive three (3) year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least 180 days before expiration.
5.2 Licensor may terminate immediately upon Licensee's (a) uncured material breach; (b) insolvency, bankruptcy filing, or assignment for the benefit of creditors; or (c) any use of the Licensed Marks outside the scope of this Agreement.

6. INFRINGEMENT AND ENFORCEMENT
6.1 Licensee shall promptly notify Licensor of any suspected infringement or dilution of the Licensed Marks.
6.2 Licensor retains sole control over enforcement, including the decision to bring or settle any action.
6.3 Licensee shall provide reasonable assistance in any enforcement action, at Licensor's expense.

7. OWNERSHIP AND GOODWILL
7.1 Licensee acknowledges Licensor's exclusive ownership of the Licensed Marks and that all goodwill arising from Licensee's use inures solely to the benefit of Licensor.

8. GOVERNING LAW; DISPUTE RESOLUTION
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware. Disputes shall be resolved by binding arbitration administered by JAMS in Wilmington, Delaware.
